title: Vanish Airbrush Full Coverage Longwear Concealer
descriptionHtml:
✓ Waterproof✓ Alcohol Free✓ Good for: Dark Circles✓ Natural Finish✓ Full Coverage✓ Long-wearing✓ Non-Comedogenic✓ Without Mineral Oil✓ Without Triclosan✓ Liquid Formula✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Without Parabens

What it is: A weightless liquid concealer that instantly delivers full, undetectable coverage with an airbrushed finish for up to 16-hour wear.


Coverage: Full


Finish: Natural


Formulation: Liquid


Skin Type: Normal, Dry, Combination, and Oily


Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, mineral oil, sulfates SLS & SLES, and triclosan. It is also vegan and cruelty-free.


What Else You Need to Know: This crease-resistant, waterproof formula conceals redness, blemishes, and dark circles while seamlessly blurring and evening the complexion.

How to Use+

Suggested Usage:

-Use applicator to apply concealer directly onto skin.

-Blend with Vanish Seamless Finish Concealer Brush (sold separately), your finger, or a beauty sponge.

-Concentrated formula requires just one to three dots under each eye.

-To conceal, select a shade that matches your natural skin tone.

-To highlight, select a concealer two shades lighter than your natural skin tone and apply to the high points of the face.

Ingredients+
Water/Aqua, Cyclopentasiloxane, Phenyl Trimethicone, Mica, Butylene Glycol, CetylPeg/Ppg-10/1 Dimethicone, Pvp, Peg-10 Dimethicone, Barium Sulfate, Sodium Chloride, VinylDimethicone/Methicone Silsesquioxane Crosspolymer, Aluminum Hydroxide, Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract, Centella Asiatica Extract, Chamomilla Recutita (Matricaria) Flower Extract, Dimethicone, Disteardimonium Hectorite, Glycyrrhiza Glabra (Licorice) Root Extract, Methicone, Myristic Acid, Palmitic Acid, Polygonum Cuspidatum Root Extract, Polysilicone-11, Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Leaf Extract, Scutellaria Baicalensis Root Extract, Squalane, Stearic Acid, Triethoxycaprylylsilane, Chlorphenesin, Phenoxyethanol, Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891), Iron Oxides (Ci 77492, Ci 77491, Ci 77499).
